title: Nonlinear Anisotropic Visco-Anelasticity
summary: We formulate a nonlinear geometric theory of visco-anelasticity that unifies viscoelastic and anelastic responses within a single thermodynamic framework. At each material point, the total deformation gradient is multiplicatively decomposed into elastic, viscous, and anelastic distortions, thereby generalizing the Bilby-Kröner-Lee decomposition to visco-anelasticity.
